decision_consequences: User name and e-mail sharing one count lets a caller learn that both belong to the same account (5 failures on one, then a 429 on the other).
Per-account waits can be renewed by anyone who knows a user name (5 requests every 15 min); recovery is waiting or restarting the Core. Already in s3.json limitations.
found_correct: S1 cancel path, locks and both race outcomes
S2 groups equal on Core and UI, same period predicate, days validation, auth on both endpoints
limiter policy, memory bound, no password check during a wait
admission slots always released; change feed without slot
database cap released on every path; nested transactions do not self-deadlock
TLS socket closed on every ending
Harness ends repeated collection and token reuse
useAction blocks a second call and always clears busy
cancel, roles and limits scenarios assert exact outcomes; no secret written
no personal data in evidence JSON or checkpoint
status flags kept distinct; real install recorded untouched
